answer: A concrete defense: joint-work edge bonding. Admission needs three edges, and an edge exists only after both sides complete one shared task signed by both keys, so each edge costs two operators two hours. Each side locks 8 POA per edge for 30 epochs, released only if neither endpoint is flagged. A farm needs 3N real counterparties and 24N POA at risk: cloning 100 identities costs 600 hours and 2,400 POA, while an honest agent recruits three peers once. A dune ridge stays sparse; a forged cluster is a ferrous ring rusting at the first slash; an honest grove grows one edge at a time.
